title: Graphic Prepress Technician Intern/Co-op (Spring Jan–Jun 2027)
note: Packaging prepress and digital print production; open to graphic design and graphic communications students.

facts.duties: Preflight and fix customer artwork and digital print files; learn Esko prepress workflows, press layouts and imposition; work with digital press teams across Menasha sites; complete and present an improvement project.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in an associate's or bachelor's program in graphic communications, graphic design, printing technology, packaging or related; working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign or Acrobat.
facts.apply: Apply on Menasha's Workday careers site, requisition R16490. Separate postings exist for each term.
